entries.title: Isaiah 51:1
segments: ¶"Listen to Me, you who follow after righteousness, You who seek the LORD: Look to the rock [from which] you were hewn, And to the hole of the pit [from which] you were dug.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:2
segments: Look to Abraham your father, And to Sarah [who] bore you; For I called him alone, And blessed him and increased him."

entries.title: Isaiah 51:3
segments: For the LORD will comfort Zion, He will comfort all her waste places; He will make her wilderness like Eden, And her desert like the garden of the LORD; Joy and gladness will be found in it, Thanksgiving and the voice of melody.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:4
segments: ¶"Listen to Me, My people; And give ear to Me, O My nation: For law will proceed from Me, And I will make My justice rest As a light of the peoples.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:5
segments: My righteousness [is] near, My salvation has gone forth, And My arms will judge the peoples; The coastlands will wait upon Me, And on My arm they will trust.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:6
segments: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, And look on the earth beneath. For the heavens will vanish away like smoke, The earth will grow old like a garment, And those who dwell in it will die in like manner; But My salvation will be forever, And My righteousness will not be abolished.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:7
segments: "Listen to Me, you who know righteousness, You people in whose heart [is] My law: Do not fear the reproach of men, Nor be afraid of their insults.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:8
segments: For the moth will eat them up like a garment, And the worm will eat them like wool; But My righteousness will be forever, And My salvation from generation to generation."

entries.title: Isaiah 51:9
segments: ¶Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of the LORD! Awake as in the ancient days, In the generations of old. [Are] You not [the arm] that cut Rahab apart, [And] wounded the serpent?

entries.title: Isaiah 51:10
segments: [Are] You not [the One] who dried up the sea, The waters of the great deep; That made the depths of the sea a road For the redeemed to cross over?

entries.title: Isaiah 51:11
segments: So the ransomed of the LORD shall return, And come to Zion with singing, With everlasting joy on their heads. They shall obtain joy and gladness; Sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:12
segments: "I, [even] I, [am] He who comforts you. Who [are] you that you should be afraid Of a man [who] will die, And of the son of a man [who] will be made like grass?

entries.title: Isaiah 51:13
segments: And you forget the LORD your Maker, Who stretched out the heavens And laid the foundations of the earth; You have feared continually every day Because of the fury of the oppressor, When [he has] prepared to destroy. And where [is] the fury of the oppressor?

entries.title: Isaiah 51:14
segments: The captive exile hastens, that he may be loosed, That he should not die in the pit, And that his bread should not fail.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:15
segments: But I [am] the LORD your God, Who divided the sea whose waves roared-The LORD of hosts [is] His name.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:16
segments: And I have put My words in your mouth; I have covered you with the shadow of My hand, That I may plant the heavens, Lay the foundations of the earth, And say to Zion, 'You [are] My people.'"

entries.title: Isaiah 51:17
segments: ¶Awake, awake! Stand up, O Jerusalem, You who have drunk at the hand of the LORD The cup of His fury; You have drunk the dregs of the cup of trembling, [And] drained [it] out.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:18
segments: [There is] no one to guide her Among all the sons she has brought forth; Nor [is there any] who takes her by the hand Among all the sons she has brought up.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:19
segments: These two [things] have come to you; Who will be sorry for you? -Desolation and destruction, famine and sword-By whom will I comfort you?

entries.title: Isaiah 51:20
segments: Your sons have fainted, They lie at the head of all the streets, Like an antelope in a net; They are full of the fury of the LORD, The rebuke of your God.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:21
segments: Therefore please hear this, you afflicted, And drunk but not with wine.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:22
segments: Thus says your Lord, The LORD and your God, [Who] pleads the cause of His people: "See, I have taken out of your hand The cup of trembling, The dregs of the cup of My fury; You shall no longer drink it.

entries.title: Isaiah 51:23
segments: But I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you, Who have said to you, 'Lie down, that we may walk over you.' And you have laid your body like the ground, And as the street, for those who walk over."
